Commentary.Commentary: So, that is it from this game then! Bangladesh's impressive record over Pakistan in recent time continues. Pakistan on the other hand, will be very, very disappointed and their World Cup campaign is more or less over. That is it from this game then, cricketing action does not end here though as there is another game going on between England and South Africa. You can catch all the action by switching tabs. Until next time, take care and goodbye!

Nigar Sultana, the victorious skipper, is in for a chat. She says she cannot believe they what they just accomplished. Mentions, they have known Pakistan since a long time and adds, the girls did work hard. Ends by saying, she hopes they keep growing with each victory and knows what her side is capable of.

Bismah Maroof, the Pakistan skipper says, this defeat is very hard to digest. Mentions they were very well in the game, but a few bad shots cost them the game. Says, it is very hard to end up on the wrong side with two close results going against them.

Fahima Khatun wins the Player of the Match for her exceptional spell with the ball. She starts by thanking the almighty. Mentions, she just kept bowling the right areas and it proved to be successful. She just aimed to bowl according to the field. Says it was a very sporty wicket and any bowlers who keep hitting the right areas will find a lot of success on this wicket.
Stay tuned for presentation...

Bangladesh for most of the part were behind in the game. Not only that, they were shambolic in the field as there were far too many misfields and dropped catches. The only good thing is they just never wanted to give up and their bowlers kept coming at the Pakistan batters. Fahima Khatun has to be the one that has won them the game. She bagged three out of which two came in one over which was the one which turned the game. Salma Khatun along with Rumana Ahmed was also brilliantly. Not all the bowlers were on song but they were a lot more hungrier to win this one and in the end, have come out on top. This is also their first win in Women's World Cup.

Pakistan will be mighty disappointed. Their top three just laid it on the plate for them. First it was Ameen and Nahida Khan, and then the former with her skipper. The three in total added 155. Run a ball was needed when Maroof was dismissed but almost no contribution from the middle and the lower order put all the responsibility on the shoulders of Ameen to taking them over the line. It was too much of an ask for the centurion and her side remains without a win.

What a win, what a win that is for Bangladesh! They looked down and out when Pakistan were two down for 155 in the 38th over but the wicket of  Maroof changed it all. It all went so wrong for them after that. They lost wickets in heaps, one after the another in no time and have fallen short by not a lot.
WHAT A WIN FOR BANGLADESH! Yorker, in the blockhole. Fatima works it to the leg side. They take one. Bangladesh Women win the game by 9 runs.
Fuller, on off. Sandhu comes down the track and pushes it to the right of the bowler for one. Nahida Akter keeps her cool in the final over.
Slower one, outside off. Fatima eases it towards point for one. 12 off 2 now.
Two now! Short ball, outside off. Fatima hangs back and cuts it through point for a brace.
Fuller, outside off. Sandhu drives it to long off for one.
Tossed up, outside off. Sandhu comes down the track and taps it to point.
Swing and a miss! Flatter, wide outside off. Fatima looks to cut it away but misses. Salma Khatun gives away only three runs in the penultimate over. Pakistan need 16 off 6 balls now.
Flatter, on middle. Sandhu flicks it to square leg for one. These singles won't hurt Bangladesh at all!
Short ball, on off. Fatima heaves it across the line. The ball flies to mid-wicket off the top edge. It lands safely and they take one.
Fuller, outside off. Fatima eases it to mid off.
A single as this worked towards point.
Short ball, outside off. Sandhu looks to cut it away but misses. It zips past the outside edge.
Full, on the pads. Sandhu tucks it to square leg for one. Pakistan Women now need 19 runs off 12 balls but they only have a single wicket in hand now.
Ghulam Fatima is the last batter in.

OUT! Sidra Ameen is short! That has to be the game for Bangladesh! Sidra Ameen was Pakistan's last hope. End of an outstanding innings from her but she will be disappointed she could not take her side over the line. This is tossed up on off, Sandhu hits it through covers and the batters go for two. Ritu Moni picks the ball up in the deep and fires it to the bowler who whips the bails off and appeals. It is taken upstairs and replays show that Ameen is short.
Is that a run out? The umpire takes it upstairs. The replays show the batter is short when the bails are coming off. Sidra Ameen has to walk back now.
Ameen now steps out and hits it to mid off, she gets way too close to the pitch of the ball. Just the one again.
Drop and run! Nashra Sandhu's job is to give Ameen the  strike and she is doing it! On off, this is played on the off side for one.

The idea was right, it just did not come off! Ameen moves right across, this is full and on middle, she sweeps but to short fine leg. A little to the left or the right and would have been a boundary. Just the one in the end.
Singles won't do it! On off, this is pushed to covers for one. Ameen is on strike though.
Another run! Not sure though why was this taken. It is Nashra Sandhu who will be on strike now! On middle, this is worked through square leg for one. End of a really good over by Salma Khatun!
Nashra Sandhu comes in at number 10.

OUT! THAT IS PLUMB! Baig, who was threatening has been dismissed. She was the one who could hit it long, now only the bowlers left. Salma Khatun, the experienced player makes the difference. She fires it on middle, Baig looks to play the paddle scoop but misses and gets hit on the pad. An appeal and the finger is raised. No reviews but we believe it would not have mattered.
Just the one again! Ameen skips down the track and hits it hard but to covers for one.
Just another single! On off, Baig probably looked to paddle scoop there, it goes off the splice towards the leg side for one.
Ameen comes down the track and hits it down to long on for one.
How is that a run? On middle, this is dropped on the left of the wicket. They go for one and complete it. Early call and trusting your partner was the key there.
A single to end! On middle, fuller, this is hit down the ground to long on for one. A decent over for Pakistan. 30 needed then in the last 4. This is turning out to be a cracker.
Dots will only build pressure. It is gold! On middle, defended.
Two more! Edgy but Pakistan won't care! Outside off, shorter. Baig cuts, it goes fine on the off side for two.
Well bowled! Slows it up and bowls it wider outside off. Baig looks to sweep, she had to drag it from outside off. Misses.
FOUR! This is exactly what Pakistan need! This is what they were missing, some intent with the bat. That is hit hard. On off, this is swept hard through mid-wicket for a boundary.
TWO WIDES! Extras will help Pakistan! Down the leg side. Baig looks to plays the paddle sweep, she misses, the keeper too fails to collect it. Two taken.
A dot! Dots are gold right now! Outside off, this is slapped towards cover. Ameen wants one but is sent back.
Another single now as this worked towards cover.

Sidra Ameen becomes the first Pakistan player to score a century in the Women's Wolrd Cup. What a knock it has been. Absolutely sensational. Although, the atmosphere is a tense one. Coming to the ball, it is short, outside off. Ameen cuts it hard to cover for a single. Can Sidra Ameen take her side home?
Fuller, on off. Ameen comes down the track and lofts it towards long on. The fielder makes a sharp stop with dive to her left in the deep. The batters take two.
Tossed up, on off. Baig pushes it to point for one.
Short, outside off. Ameen cuts it to point for one. She moves to 97.
Looped up, outside off. Baig guides it to point for a quick single.
Diana Baig is the new batter in.

OUT! Nawaz is well short. There was never two there. It is all falling apart for Pakistan a little too quickly. Also, with this being the last ball, why did Ameen go for the second, really not sure. Short and outside off, this is slapped through covers. They take one and go for the second. The fielder in the deep, runs to her right, picks the ball up and throws it flat and to the bowler who collects it and whips the bails off. An appeal and it is taken upstairs. Replays show that the batter is very short.
Is that a run out? The umpire takes it upstairs to confirm. The replays show that Sidra Nawaz is well short of her crease. The big screen displays OUT.
On off, this is hit to mid off for one.
Loopy ball, outside off. Nawaz pushes it to the off side.
Sidra Nawaz is the new batter in.

OUT! THREE REDS AGAIN! Pakistan have lost two batter and two reviews in the last two deliveries. Bangladesh are all over Pakistan now. Ameen now probably has to do it by herself now. What an over this is by Fatima. Two huge wickets in it. This is the slider. It lands on middle and goes on with the angle. Sana plays down the wrong line. She misses to get hit on the front pad. A very confident appeal and the finger is raised. Sana reviews, not sure why and replays return with THREE REDS!
Fatima Sana is the new batter in.

It is looped up, around leg, with some extra bounce. Riaz goes inside the crease and ends up playing all around it. She gets hit on her pads. Fahima Khatun appeals and the umpire agrees to it. Aliya Riaz reviews straightaway. She thinks it is very high. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking shows three reds. Aliya Riaz trudges back to the dugout along with a review as well.
Tossed up, on middle. Ameen flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball, on middle and leg. Ameen works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball, outside off. Sidra Ameen cuts it behind square on the off side.
Full length, outside off. Ameen defends it out solidly.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust for Pakistan Women. Rumana Ahmed picks up her second wicket. It is tossed up, full and on off. Dar get low and tries to sweep it away. The ball though flies towards short fine leg off the top edge. Sobhana Mostary, the substitute fielder, runs to her right and takes a solid catch.
Commentary.Howout: c sub Sobhana Mostary b Rumana Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller, on middle and leg. Ameen clips it through mid on for a single.
Length, outside off, turns in off the deck. Ameen defends it watchfully.

OUT! CAUGHT! Omaima Sohail goes back on a timid score. A timely wicket for Bangladesh Women. It is a full-length ball, on off. Omaima Sohail heaves it forcefully to the right of mid on. Nigar Sultana moves to that side and takes a brilliant catch. Can Bangladesh Women build on this? Nida Dar is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Fargana Hoque b Fahima Khatun

Commentary.Commentary: A single as this is worked towards cover.
Fuller, down leg. Ameen sweeps it to fine leg for a brace.
On off, Ameen defends it out solidly.
Full length, on off. Ameen pushes it to cover.
Slower through the air, full and on off. Sohail looks to sweep it away, It takes the top-edge and goes above the keeper's head for a single.
FOUR! Glorious drive, this! Full length, outside off. Ameen leans in and creams it through the cover region for a boundary.
Length ball, on off. Ameen pushes it out.
Another single, as this is worked towards mid-wicket.
Length ball, around off, It nips in a touch. Ameen pushes it to cover for a single.
Length, outside off. Sohail cuts it through covers for a brace.
Full length, outside off. Ameen pushes it to cover for a single.
WIDE! Another one wide outside off. Now the keeper is walking down to the other end to have a word with the bowler. Not a good start to the over.
WIDE! On a length, outside off, shaping away. Sidra Ameen lets it go. The umpire signals another wide.
WIDE! Length ball, outside off, moving away. Ameen leaves it alone. Wide called.
Full and on off. Ameen sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for one. This brings an end to the second Powerplay.
On off, defended out.
Touch short, outside off. Sohail cuts it through point for one.
Wide outside off, Ameen pushes it to the off side for one more.
Fuller, on leg. Sohail clips it to fine leg for a single.
Short, outside off. Ameen cuts it to point for one.

FOUR! EDGY! Nahida Akter bangs her hand on the deck in anguish. It is tossed up, outside off. Omaima Sohail throws her blade at it. The ball goes past the keeper off the outside edge and into the fence at third man.
Fuller, on off, blocked out.
Short ball, outside off. Ameen cuts it to point. The fielder fumbles and the batters take one.
Fuller, outside off. Omaima Sohail drives it to long off for one.
Full length, outside off. Sohail defends it off the inner half.
Fuller, outside off. Omaima Sohail defends it back to the bowler.
Full length, on off. Ameen drives it past mid off and collects a brace.
Omaima Sohail is the new batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Jahanara Alam has the last laugh here. Just when Bismah Maroof decides to put her foot on the gas, she perishes. A full-length ball, on off. Some extra bounce off the deck this time. Bismah Maroof looks to heave it across the line but it flies off the top-edge toward mid-wicket. Sharmin Akhter runs backwards and takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Sharmin Akhter b Jahanara Alam

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! A much-needed boundary for Pakistan. Bismah Maroof breakes the shackles now. Length ball, outside off. Maroof pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full toss, on middle and leg. Ameen flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
150 up for Pakistan. Full length, outside off. Maroof slaps it down the ground for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Maroof defends it to cover.
This time Bangladesh denies them to take the single. Looped up, outside off. Ameen steers it to backward point. The fielder does well to pounce on it quickly.
Fuller, on off. Maroof clips it to mid on for another quick single.
Length, outside off. Ameen reaches out and guides it to backward point for one.
Fuller, on off. Ameen plays it back to the bowler.
Flighted, full and on off. Bismah Maroof tucks it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
A single now! Back of a length, outside off. Ameen cuts it to point for one.

DRINKS! Pakistan Women need 90 runs off 84 balls. Pakistan have a lot of wickets in hand, although the current pair is unable to free their arms at the moment. Hopefully, it does not prove to be costly later on. Bangladesh, on the flip side, have created several chances but have been very poor in the field. They have dropped a couple of catches. Bangladesh have themselves to blame, if they crumble under pressure as the game progresses.
Back of a length, outside off. Ameen cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Maroof taps it to point for a quick single. Salma Khatun is not happy with the fielder.
Full, on off. Maroof defends it out.
Full length, on off. Ameen guides it to backward point for one.
Length ball, around off. Ameen goes back and chops it to cover.
Short ball, outside off. Maroof cuts it through point for one. The stands moves to 51 now.

An easy single to end the over, as this is worked to long on. Bangladesh Women are finding it difficult to keep up with the left-right combination. They are losing a lot of time in changing the field.
Short, outside off. Ameen steers it down to third man. The fielder gives it a chase and does well to save a boundary. They take three.
Maroof sweeps this full delivery to deep square leg for one.
A dot now! Full, on off, blocked out.
One more! Short outside off, turning away. Ameen cuts it to sweeper cover.
One run to welcome Nahida Akter back into the attack. It is fuller, on off. Maroof clips it to square leg for a single.
Full length, outside off. Maroof drives it through covers for one. A good over by Salma Khatun.
Fuller, outside off. Maroof lunges and defends it into the deck.
Short, outside off. Maroof cuts it hard to point.
Good length, outside off. Maroof works it towards backward point.
Flatter, outside off. Maroof guides it to third man.
Full length, on off. Ameen sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Much-needed boundary for Pakistan. A length ball, on the pads. Bismah Maroof stays back and glances it down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. They need 103 off 102 balls now.
Fuller, outside off. Ameen works it to sweeper cover for one more.
Length ball, outside off. Maroof guides it to third man for one.
A single as this is worked towards sweeper cover.
Fuller, on the pads. Bismah Maroof flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Length ball, on the stumps. Maroof defends it out.
On off, blocked out.
Looped up, on off. Ameen puches it to sweeper cover for two.
Fuller, on the pads. Maroof clips it to mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up, full and on off. Ameen swings hard and lobs it over mid off. It is tantalizingly close to the fielder. They take one, as it lands safely.
Fuller, down leg, Maroof clips it to square leg for one.
Back of a length, outside off. Ameen cuts it to point for one.

DROPPED! What a chance. Bangladesh Women are unable to tighten the screws here. Full length, on off. Sidra Ameen tries to heave it across the line, it flies off the top-edge and goes square on the off side. Nigar Sultana gets under it but spills it out. They take one.
On a length, outside off, shaping away. Ameen leaves it alone.
Fuller, outside off. Maroof drives it through covers for a single.
Full length, on middle and leg. Maroof tucks it to the leg side.
Full length, on off. Maroof defends it solidly. The required rate creeps up above 6 for the first time during the chase.
It is short, outside off, angled across the left-hander. Bismah Maroof tries to cut it away without any foot movement though. She gets beaten on her outside edge.
A single now! She retains strike! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for one. 119 needed then in 120 balls.
Make that 5! Pressure building on Maroof! Outside off, Maroof looks to sweep but misses.
4 dots now! Outside off, Maroof looks to cut but misses.
Make that 3 now! On middle, this is pulled to mid-wicket.
Two dots in a row! Maroof comes down and works it to mid-wicket.
On middle, this is swept to short fine leg.
MISFIELD AND FOUR! That releases some pressure and the last ball spoils the over! Outside off, this is hit towards cover, the fielder lets it through and it races away to the fence.

DROPPED! That was not easy! A good effort from Sanjida Akter! This is outside off, it is dragged towards mid on. Akter there dives to her right and gets two hands to it but it does not stay in. It would have been a brilliant and an important catch.
Outside off, Mahroof guides it down to third man for one.
Around off, this is hit through covers for one more.
Ameen now makes room! She gets a short one around off, it is cut but to point.
On off, this is pushed to covers.

Bismah Maroof was seen talking to the umpire. She had an issue with some sticker on her blade. A few options come out for Maroof to choose from and she does not take much time to make a choice. It is very unusual to see this happen right now becuase the officials do inspect the bats before the game.
A single to end a good over for Pakistan! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Gives it air and bowls it on off, Ameen hits it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Too short and put away! Finally, a boundary for Pakistan and it is a welcome one. Shorter and outside off, Ameen hangs back and slaps it through covers. This one races away to the fence.
That is a quick run! On middle, this is pushed to mid on for one.
Floats it up on middle, this i swept towards short fine leg.

Fifty for Ameen! A really good knock but she would know, the job is only half done. She needs to go on and we probably will see her step on the gas now. She gets there by slapping this through covers for one.
Another dot as this is worked to mid-wicket.
On off, this is pushed to covers.

In the air... safe! Lucky escape! On middle, Ameen looks to flick but closes the face of the bat early. It goes off the leading edge over point. The fielder runs back and dives but does not reach it. One taken.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Good length and on off, defended.
Full, on off. Ameen defends it out solidly.
Floated, full and on off. Sidra Ameen gets an inside edge onto the pads. Fahima Khatun appeals but the umpire shows no interest.
Length, outside off. Ameen cuts it to backward point. Straight to the fielder.
Flighted, full, around off. Maroof tucks it to mid-wicket for an easy single.
Short, outside off. Ameen cuts it through covers on the back foot for a single.
Looped up, full and on the stumps. Ameen goes back and pushes it to cover.
A dot to end! On off, defended.
That is really good running! On the pads, this is worked through square leg with soft hands. They take one and want the second, complete it.
On middle, this is pushed back to the bowler.
Good length and on off, Maroof blocks it well.
Nicely played again! Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Really good running! On middle, this is worked towards mid-wicket and a single is taken.
Two more! Angled into the pads, this is swept through square leg for two.
Maroof is off the mark! On the pads, this is worked towards backward square leg for one.
Bismah Maroof comes in at number 3.

OUT! TIMBER! There is the wicket Bangladesh needed and probably at the right time. The two would have stepped on the gas soon. Now, they will need to re-build again. Still though, end of an excellent opening stand and they have laid the platform for the chase. This is shorter and outside off, Khan goes back and looks to pull, she tries to drag it on the leg side but gets an inside edge onto the stumps. Can Bangladesh build on this now? 144 more needed.
Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for one.
Tossed up nicely and on middle, defended.
Flatter and on off, this is guided to point.
Just the single! An excellent over then from Ritu! On off, this is pushed through covers.
5 now! Another one fuller and on off, Khan strokes it to covers.
Make that 5! Fuller and on off, Khan pushes it to covers.
4 dots in a row now! On off, this is pushed to covers.
On off, this is guided to point.
Good length and on off, this is pushed to covers.
A dot here and there is fine! On off, Ameen plays it to point. Bangladesh on the other hand, will have to look for ways to bowl dots.
Shorter and outside off, Khan cuts it through point and takes one. This is what they need, just keep rotating the strike and they will be home.
Shorter and outside off, Ameen pushes it through covers for one.
On the pads, this is swept through square leg for one more.
On off, defended.
Another run! On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Full length, outside off. Ameen guides it to third man for one. Just three runs off it.
Overpitched, outside off. Ameen pushes it to cover on the front foot.
Full length, on off. Ameen plays it back to the bowler.
Touch short, outside off. Ameen taps it to point.
Looped up, on middle. Ameen defends it out solidly.
WIDE! This one is well wide outside off, left alone.
A single to start the 21st over! Full length, outside off. Khan slashes it to deep point for one.
Good stop! Shorter and outside off, Ameen cuts it hard but the fielder at point dives to her left and stops it.
Floats it up on off, blocked.
A single now as this is swept through square leg.
On off, this is pushed to cover.

Direct hit but Ameen is in! The dive saves her! On off, this is pushed towards cover. Ameen wants one but is sent back. The bowler gets to the ball, picks it up and hits the stumps at the bowler's end. Ameen is in. She had lost her bat when she dived but the whole of her body was inside the crease.
Two more! The sweep is out, it is hit through square leg for a couple.
Angled into the pads, it is worked through square leg.
Two more! Shorter and outside off, Khan waits and then guides it through point for a couple.
Another dot! On off, this is pushed to covers.
Another dot! Outside off, it is cut to point.
On middle, this is worked to mid-wicket.
Two more! Shorter and outside off, Khan slaps it through covers for two.

DRINKS! Pakistan Women are cruising at the moment. The opening stand has stitched up 73 runs until now. Bangladesh bowlers have failed to keep things tight so far. They need some quick wickets to make inroads in this game. An interesting passage of play awaits.
Another dot to end! Outside off, Ameen looks to guide it down to third man but misses.
Fuller and on off, Ameen hits it hard but back to the bowler.
Outside off, it is played to point.
The sweep is out again, it is hit through square leg for one.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Into the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
A quick run to end a good over for Pakistan! On middle, this is pushed to mid on.
A low full toss on the pads, this is worked through square leg for one.
On off, this is guided down to third man for one.
Two more! On the pads, this is worked through square leg. Two is the call and two is what they get.
Fuller and on off, this one comes back in. Khan looks to push it through covers but it goes off the inner half through mid-wicket for one.
Good length and on off, defended.
Flatter and on off, Ameen defends.
FOUR! A welcome, welcome boundary for Pakistan! Powerful sweep, it is on middle, she hits it hard through square leg for a boundary.
Around off, this is guided to point.
The sweep is out, it is hit through square leg for one.
The batter misses out! Shorter and on middle, it is pulled but to mid-wicket.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
A single to end! So a good over then after that chat! The last ball is fuller, it is worked wide of mid on for one.
Back of a length and on middle, defended.
Fuller and on middle, this is pushed to mid on.
Good length and on off, Ameen blocks.
Well wide outside off, left alone.
Whatever that chat was, has worked. Length and on off, defended.
WIDE! Slips this one down the leg side. Wided. A chat from the captain with the bowler. Nice to see, Fariha Trisna has not been at her best today.

That should not have been a single! On off, Ameen pushes it towards cover and takes off. The fielder runs in and fires it to the keeper who does not collect it. The batter would have been in. Risky run that. The dot ball pressure is getting to the batter.
The sweep comes out, it is hit through mid-wicket for one.
Outside off, shorter. It is slapped through covers for one.
On off, blocked.
Floats it up on off, this is pushed to mid on.
Flatter and on off, this is guided to point.

FOUR! That should release the pressure somewhat! A streaky boundary but Pakistan won't care! Flatter and on off, this lands and turns away. Khan looks to push, it goes off the outside edge down to the third man fence.
Another dot! Shorter and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Fifty up for Pakistan! On off, this is pushed to covers for one. They need to keep picking singles.
Runs have dried up completely. Fuller and outside off, this is jammed out to point.
On middle, defended.
Shorter and outside off, Ameen cuts it to point.
Another dot to end! Bangladesh have done well in the last few overs. On off, this is played to point. 186 more needed.
Floats it up and on off, Khan plays it to covers.
Looks to drop and run again but is sent back.
Another run! Soft hands! On off, this is played towards point for one.
Need to rotate the strike a lot more. On off, this is played on the off side for one.
N6 dots in a row now! On off, this is yet again played to point. Struggling to find the gap in that area.
Another dot to end! Around off, this is guided to point again.
Yet another dot! Outside off, Ameen cuts but finds point.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Quicker and flatter outside off, Ameen plays it to backward point.
Flatter and around off, this is cut to point.
Drop and run! Sensible batting is call of the hour right now! On off, this is pushed towards cover for one.
End of Powerplay 1! Now, 4 fielders can be placed outside the inner circle until the end of the 40th over.
Fuller, outside off. Ameen defends it to the off side.
Touch short, outside off. Ameen cuts it to point.
Full length, outside off. Ameen pushes it through point for a brace.
Another dot now. Floated, full, on off. Ameen eases it out.
Tossed up, on the stumps, Ameen works it to point.
Full, on off, Sidra Ameen works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! What a shot. Short ball, outside off. Khan cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
Tossed up, on off, fuller. Khan defends it out.
Fuller, on off, pushed to cover.
Swing and a miss! A short ball, outside off. Khan hangs on her back foot and tries to cut it away. She misses, gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length, on off. Khan punches it to cover.
Full length, on off. Khan leans in to defend it into the deck.
On off, Ameen remains solid in her defense.
On the stumps, blocked out solidly.
Looped up, full and on leg. Khan looks to sweep it away. It takes the top-edge and evades the short fine leg fielder. One taken.
Around off, blocked out watchfully.
Full, on off, defended to point.
Fuller, on the stumps. Ameen sweeps it behind square on the leg side for one.
Full, on middle and leg. Ameen sweeps it to fine leg for one.
WIDE! Full,down leg. Ameen misses her flick. Wide called.
FOUR! Sidra Ameen is off to a great start. Full, outside off. Ameen drives it through covers for a boundary.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Nahida Khan sweeps it to deep square leg for one.
Darted on the pads. Khan clips it to fine leg for two runs.
Looped up, outside off. Khan defends it to cover on the front foot.
Slower through the air, full, on off. Khan defends it back to the bowler.
Fuller, outside off. Khan defends it towards point for one. 6 runs off the over then.
Flaoted, full and on leg. Ameen sweeps it towards fine leg for just a single.
Short, outside off. Ameen pushes it to cover.
FOUR! Swept away nicely! Full length, on leg. Sidra Ameen gets low and sweeps it down to fine leg for a boundary.
Fuller, on off, Ameen defends it out.
Short and on off. Ameen pushes it to cover.
Changing the angle works really well for Jahanara Alam. Full length, outside off. Khan pushes it to cover.
Three dots in a row! Full length, outside off. Khan leans in to block it to cover.
Good length, angled across the right-hander. Khan leaves it alone for the keeper.
Jahanara Alam comes 'round the wicket now. A length ball, on off. Nahida Khan defends it out solidly.
FOUR! Nahida Khan is off to a bright start. Full length, down the leg side. Khan waits, sweeps it to fine leg for a boundary. Jahanara Alam is unable to use the new ball well.
Length ball, outside off. Khan slashes it to deep point for a brace.
Full length, on the stumps. Ameen presses forward, defends it into the deck. Just a boundary off the over then.
FOUR! Nicely played! A length ball, outside off. Ameen goes back and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
It is fuller, wide outside off. Ameen tries to reach it but misses.
Fuller, outside off. Ameen pushes it to cover for one. Fariha Trisna yet to get one back into the right-hander.
Full-length ball, outside off. Ameen tries to slash it away but misses.
Full length, angled across the right-hander. Ameen pushes it out to safety.
A single to end the over! Length ball, outside off. Ameen opens the face of the blade late, guides it down to third man for one. Only 3 runs off the over.
Make that three! A short ball, on top of off. Ameen stays back and blocks it to cover.
Two dots in a row! Full length, on off, moving away a hint. Ameen gets behind it and defends it out.
Full length, on off. Ameen eases it to mid on.
Low full toss, outside leg. Khan sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
WIDE! Full length, sliding down leg. Khan tries to chase it but misses. Wide called by the umpire.
Length ball, outside off, shaping away. Khan leaves it alone for the keeper.
FOUR! Down the ground! Full toss, on off. Ameen slaps it hard past mid off. It races away to the boundary line. 10 on the board for Pakistan.
Full length, outside off. Ameen prods and defends it out.
Back of a length, outside off. Ameen cuts it through the point region for a brace now.
A slower ball, full and on off. Khan pushes it to mid off and scampers across for a quick single. Ritu Moni has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses.
Fuller, on off. Khan drives it to mid off.
Full length, wide outside off. Khan reaches out and taps it to cover.
Fariha Trisna to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
A single to end the first! Full length, around off. Nahida Khan pushes it to point for a single.
Two dots in a row now! On a length, outside off, shaping away off the deck. Khan leaves it alone for the keeper.
Full length, outside off. Khan bunts it into covers.
Short ball, outside off. Sidra Ameen hangs back and cuts it hard to deep point for one.
Full length, on middle and leg. Ameen clips it to mid-wicket.

Nahida Khan and Pakistan Women are off the mark in an edgy fashion. A full-length ball, around off. Nahida Khan tries to defend it out. Although, the ball swings away off the deck, takes the outside edge and goes to third man for one.
